title: Reverse Swing (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 106bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal cricket late movement
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Reverse swing is for later in the day
When the ball is old and the pitch is tired
And the batsman thinks the hard part is over
That's when reverse swing says — actually

[Verse 2]
The old ball swings the other way
Against everything the batsman has learned
Forty overs of muscle memory
And now the ball has different opinions

[Chorus]
Reverse swing says — you've been here before
Reverse swing says — except you haven't
Reverse swing says — you know what an old ball does
Reverse swing says — not this old ball

[Bridge]
Chas said — reverse swing is the reward for patience
The ball has to be worked to that condition
One side rough, one side smooth
And when the conditions are right
The ball remembers what it used to do and does the opposite

[Verse 3]
It's the hardest delivery to explain to someone who hasn't watched it
And the easiest to understand when you've seen it once
The late movement
The disbelief on the batsman's face
That's reverse swing saying hello

[Outro]
Reverse swing
Reverse swing
That's my boy
